title: Research Methodology Record
description: Schema for a single methodology record in the synthetic UX research methodology database. One file per methodology in the methodologies/ folder. File named by methodology_id.

methodology_id.description: Snake_case identifier used as the database lookup key

display_name.description: Human-readable label shown in the UI

runner_type.description: task_based: turn-by-turn navigation. reaction_based: one or two turn concept evaluation. impression_based: single-turn emotional/aesthetic response.

description.description: What this methodology is and when to use it

fields.description: JSON fields the evaluator expects in each persona turn response

persona_instructions.description: Appended to the persona system prompt to explain what to return each turn

planner_guidance.description: Instruction string passed to the research planner agent to guide plan generation for this methodology

section_03_label.description: Label for the Methodology section in the report

section_03_content.description: Ordered list of content blocks to render in section 03

section_04_label.description: Label for the Key Findings section in the report

section_04_content.description: Ordered list of content blocks to render in section 04

hypothesis_focus.description: What hypotheses for this methodology should test
